purpose: Teach: 奴ら/巷/傍ら/導き/綴っ/無けれ/しかり/情景

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがニュースで「奴ら」って表現を嫌うのよ
lines.en: Sho, your father really dislikes when the news uses words like 'yatsura.'
lines.style: Warm observation, speaking to her son with gentle clarity. Conversational pace, slightly reflective—the tone of someone noticing something tender about her partner.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、巷で話題のスイーツを買ってきたよ
lines.en: Mom, I got those sweets everyone's been talking about!
lines.style: Bright, eager arrival. Quick attack on the first word. Open, unguarded excitement—the natural pride of a six-year-old bringing home a small treasure.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが本の傍らにメモを取られたわ
lines.en: Sho, I found your father taking notes beside one of his books.
lines.style: Soft discovery in her voice. Slight pause before 'taking notes'—the pleasure of noticing something quietly intentional. Warm and wondering.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんの導きでぼくは成長してるよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad helps me grow. Because of him, I'm becoming better.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity. Careful, not performed—a child speaking something he's felt but hadn't quite said aloud before. Steady, unhurried pace.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが日記に綴って残されてるのよ
lines.en: Sho, your father writes these things down in his diary—he keeps them.
lines.style: Pleased recognition in the tone. Gentle emphasis on 'keeps'—as if she's discovered something precious about his care. Warm, almost wondering.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが無ければ家族は寂しいよ
lines.en: Mom, without Dad, our family would be lonely.
lines.style: Simple, clear statement from a child who understands something true. No hesitation, but delivered softly—the weight of a small person recognizing something real.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんのお話もしかり、深い学びがあるわ
lines.en: Sho, your grandfather's stories are like that too—there's real depth in what he teaches.
lines.style: Reflective connection-making. Linking one wisdom to another with quiet conviction. Warm, maternal tone—sharing an insight without needing agreement.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが情景描写の上手な作家だって
lines.en: Mom, Dad's such a skilled writer. The way he describes things.
lines.style: Recognizing something for the first time, or seeing it afresh. Slight wonder at the discovery. Not breathless—measured, genuine admiration from a six-year-old noticing.
